deviations: Reviewer-b round-1 fixes applied: (1) reopen_period_precheck is now a dedicated reopen precheck (state closed/eligible, no close blockers, independent digest) instead of calling the close precheck; (2) verify_integrity validates legal transitions and the reopen chain (close only initial or after reopened; reopen only immediately after closed; closing(n)->closed(n+1); reject duplicate close/reopen/orphan transitions) with sequence-gap/double-reopen/latest-state/cancelled-with-run/receipt-mismatch probes; (3) scoped tests assert LedgerEntry/AccountingEvent/revenue/cost/cash/OpenItem counts unchanged for period/project close+reopen dry_run and real; (4) pm is denied period precheck/page (pm remains limited to managed-project project precheck); (5) ProjectClose UPDATE/DELETE trigger probes and project dry_run/token replay/changed-input tests added; (6) report/handoff BASE/threshold/full-suite text corrected and the superseded rejection review block cleared.

PH-336 planning slot applied: BASE fcb7b17 sets PH-322 ready and adds pmo_plugins/delivery/models.py, pmo_plugins/delivery/migrations/*, core/management/commands/verify_integrity.py and tests/test_v1_cash_book_bridge.py to allowed_paths; this branch was rebased onto fcb7b17 (old 987ec1e base not kept) and verify-change is green.

Query-count threshold evidence: the close verifier uses 4 fixed bulk queries (AccountingPeriod list, PeriodCloseRun list, ProjectClose list, close DeliveryReceipt list) and does not add per-row queries; the measured total is 88 vs the previous frozen ceiling 84 (baseline 84 + 4 fixed). The PH-336 whitelist allowed the test file, and its ceiling was bumped to exactly 88 with an explanatory comment (PH-269/274 precedent), not an arbitrary larger value.

closing is a transactional phase, not a durable observable state: the committed history contains the pair closing(n)+closed(n+1); reads/verifier treat a dangling closing as corruption. This follows PH-312's frozen decision B and does not add a closing branch to owner period/project checks.

Period precheck/project precheck reuse existing owner read services with conservative issue-code mapping; unsupported read sources are reported as missing (not as 0) and no second reconciliation rule is created. Cash bank issues are read via bank_account_issues dict issue_count, not treated as a list.

request_token idempotency uses DeliveryReceipt (action/digest/result_id); run request_token is stored only on the first (closing/reopened) row and is null on the paired closed row, matching the frozen PH-312 model constraint.

No core model/migration is changed; only existing AccountingPeriod.status/closed_through and Project.stage/previous_stage current rows are updated in the same transaction as the run pair and audit/receipt.
No automatic correction, export, notification push, PAT/MCP close tool or customer portal is added; no business fact is written by close/reopen.
